title: Interview: John Lennon for Crawdaddy | 1973
content:
John Lennon gave an interview to Crawdaddy magazine on 15 November 1973.

It was one of a series of interviews to promote his Mind Games album. The interviewers Jack Breschard and Patrick Snyder-Scumpy were joined by photographer Tom Zimberof.

The interview was published in the March 1974 edition of Crawdaddy.
